set.body:
Outcome

Make warning-clean and cross-platform behavior executable policy.

Acceptance

- MVPA fails on applicable unused, value-discard, non-unit, deprecation, feature, and unchecked warnings with narrow documented exceptions.
- Formatting is checked without unrelated rewrites.
- JVM, Scala.js FastOpt tests, and optimized Scala.js linking or execution are required gates.
- Public compile-negative and error-message tests remain stable.
set.title: P7.2: enforce strict compiler, formatting, and optimized Scala.js gates
